text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To return Wonder Acute to how she used to 
be, as if nothing had ever happened. Such 
a wish was—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *gasp*... *whew*... 
*cough*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Harsh reality quickly taught me that it 
was far too good to be true.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... I just can't seem to 
shake this fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's strange. I know I ought to do 
something about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't... strange. In fact, it was 
only natural. As her Trainer, I know all 
too well that her spirit has completely 
withered away."
choice_data_list: Let's just take it easy and not rush.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes... I'm terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, there is still hope for 
recovery. Yes—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she carries a wish on her shoulders, an 
Umamusume will... to make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Umamusume-san! See how well 
they can walk now~!

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to that Umamusume~! 
Watching her race made me feel like I need 
to do my best too."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. That's wonderful, Grandma~

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Young lady! Ever since that race, everyone 
has been super fired up!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
She was so fired up, saying she'd wear the 
championship belt someday! And of course, 
so am I! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Something to look forward 
to, then.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I couldn't reach them back then, 
but this time, my running truly reached 
them, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Serving as a splint to support everyone's 
recovery so firmly...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This makes pushing myself feel totally 
worth it. Yes, indeed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she carries a wish on her shoulders, an 
Umamusume can stand back up. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That wish, too—is already coming true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—February 17th. On the television 
broadcast:

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An invitation arrived today. So I, Smart 
Falcon, will—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Stepping away from the Twinkle Series, 
she'll be taking on an international GⅠ in 
Dubai☆

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco... san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The news of Smart Falcon taking on Dubai 
came suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You all remember, right? Several Umamusume 
were invited to Dubai last year too. Both 
dirt and turf runners.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The result was a brilliant one-two finish! 
However...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The turf girl won... Even on a track where 
dirt Umamusume were supposed to have the 
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like next is dirt's turn. That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pull off a reverse one-two 
finish! Together with Flash-san, who was 
invited along with me—!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will be taking part as well, but I have 
no intention of settling for second place, 
of course.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This might be my last chance to show 'that 
person' a victory, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Smart Falcon on the dirt, and Eishin 
Flash on the turf, both heading overseas 
together, huh."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Still, is the Twinkle Series going to be 
all right? Especially the dirt division, 
if Smart Falcon were to leave...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Up until now, I thought I had 
to pull everyone forward as troupe leader, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because there are girls we can rely on 
now! So go to Dubai without any worries!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and her German Umamusume 
roommate, Eishin Flash, have decided to 
take on the challenge in Dubai. Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to run with Wonder Acute 
for a while. She won't be there to pull me 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see... Falco-san too... is going far 
away...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So you're moving on to the next stage, 
aren't you? In that case... hey, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose it's... all a matter of 
perspective. This body that won't move the 
way I want it to..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush into anything, you 
know. You don't have to push yourself so 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, it seemed as though... Wonder 
Acute's expression had changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's always had the vibe of an old 
grandma, but this is almost like—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training to get back in top form continues 
after that. However...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that should do it. Now then, how 
about taking a little break?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, here. Have some of these crunchy 
snacks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll build up some energy and give the 
Kashiwa Kinen everything I've got, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The recovery... is far from promising... 
The drive to recklessly chase brilliance 
has vanished as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst such a sudden change in 
environment, what will become of Wonder 
Acute from here on out...?
